svg.aria-label: qa: QA evidence that holds up in review. Four sub-skills for web portals, one team format. Steps: answer-review, four lenses, one remark per row; export-evidence, every export clicked, verified; excel-import, validate, submit, check the DB; ticket-report, the result on the Jira ticket. Output: an evidence .xlsx and a report on the ticket.
